verify_body:
Complete the steps below to unlock the server.

### 1. Choose Your Language
Click **Verify** and select your preferred language. Your Discord language is used as the initial suggestion; you can change it before continuing.

**English is the default. You may select one additional language, or none.**

### 2. Read the Rules
Read the rules in <#1546465989896568873>. Make sure you understand and agree to follow all community rules, then continue to the agreement step.

### 3. Agree & Get LV1 Access
Click **✅ I Have Read & Agree to the Rules** in the private verification window.

You will receive **LV1**, unlocking the main server channels and features. If you selected an additional language, its role will also be assigned, unlocking dedicated language channels, language-specific bot features and other features available for that language.

Your community role will automatically level up based on your activity and participation, unlocking more features as you progress.

You can change your language later in <#1546918875235360928>.

### 4. Explore the Community
Once verified, explore the server, join conversations and enjoy the community!

Use **Translate** to view this information in your preferred language. Viewing a translation does not complete verification.
